scope: Targeted secondary-cast audit of named skills and observed equipment. Reveal positions follow the corpus, including retrospective reports. Unknown ranks and quantities remain unknown. Descriptive item labels do not imply official names. This is not a complete inventory reconstruction.

events.subject: Hekla
events.name: Repeating crossbow
events.summary: Hekla is identified as the crawler carrying the repeating crossbow. Earlier anonymous sightings do not establish her identity.

events.subject: Hekla
events.name: Glittering breastplate
events.summary: Hekla is observed wearing a glittering breastplate. Its bonuses are unstated.

events.subject: Hekla
events.name: Repeating crossbow
events.summary: Katia reveals that she recovered Hekla’s crossbow. It is no longer in Hekla’s possession.

events.subject: Hekla
events.name: Crossbow properties revealed
events.summary: Inspection identifies Hekla’s former weapon as the Enchanted Repeating Crossbow of the Scavenger Mother of Mothers, which can cast Birth Defect. This is an equipment property revealed after its transfer, not a learned skill.

events.subject: Eva
events.name: Sabers

events.subject: Eva
events.name: Saber identified
events.summary: The saber Carl recovered from Eva is identified as Left Fang of the Green Sultan, half of her matched magical pair. This name is first revealed here.
